intent: Formalise Forge Theory and the Universal Behavioural Virtual Machine 3.0 architecture to resolve Digital Schizophrenia and establish Meaning Sovereignty.

interpretation.this_is: The official UBVM 3.0 Whitepaper — the foundational architectural thesis for Forge Theory.
purpose: Establish the core problem of Digital Schizophrenia
Present the Semantic Capsule Protocol (SCP) as the solution for Meaning Sovereignty
Detail the UBVM architecture (Primitives, Event Bus, Strategy Loop)
Outline UBVM 2.0 distributed nodes and UBVM 3.0 autonomous organisms (BuddAI, Data Cube)
importance: The separation of meaning from execution
BuddAI and Data Cube as ultimate realizations
ignore: Domain-specific trading strategies (defer to legion capsules)
dont_change: The definitions of Digital Schizophrenia and Meaning Sovereignty
The relationship between SCP and UBVM
The overarching goals of Forge Theory

guarantees: This capsule anchors the conceptual and architectural vision of UBVM 3.0.
The axioms defined here serve as the guiding philosophy for all downstream ecosystem development.
Digital Schizophrenia is the core problem; Meaning Sovereignty is the invariant solution.
non_guarantees: Strict implementation details or API signatures.
Timeline of completion for UBVM 3.0 autonomous organisms.
semantic_contract.conflict_resolution: For structural or execution rules, prefer ubvm/spec. For semantic rules, prefer scp/spec. For overarching architectural intent and vision, this whitepaper governs.

provenance.author: James / Giblets Creations
provenance.context: Created to formally anchor the published UBVM 3.0 Whitepaper as a self-aware, semantic artefact within the UBVM ecosystem.
